analyst_view.overall: Brighton (5th of 36, 7 points) host Universitatea Craiova (8th, also 7 points), so a top-eight place is at stake for both. Brighton lost 2-0 at Hull on Sunday and play Newcastle at the weekend, so some rotation is likely; Mitoma, Ferguson, Tzimas and Yohanna are out and already in the numbers, and Hurzeler said midfielder Malick Yalcouyé (who scored the winner at Getafe) hurt himself with Ivory Coast and is out for a few weeks, which the numbers don't list. Craiova, top in Romania after a 6-2 win at UTA Arad, have named a full travelling squad: Al-Hamlawi is fit again after a minor knock, and Stevanovic and Cicâldău are both in it, so the doubts raised yesterday have gone; only Isenko is out, as the numbers know. German referee Matthias Jöllenbeck, who has shown 5.3 cards a game in his three on record, is already counted. I keep a small cut on Brighton's attack for rotation and Yalcouyé.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.5 goals, 2.9 of them for Brighton, with Mitoma, Ferguson, Tzimas and Yohanna counted and 3% already off for Brighton's 4 goals in their last six. They can't see a rotated side between Hull and Newcastle or Yalcouyé's absence, while Craiova arrive with a settled, full-strength team, so I trim 3%, to about 3.4 goals.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.5 corners, 8.2 of them Brighton's. Even a changed Brighton side will keep the ball and push Craiova's back three deep, which is what the numbers expect, and Craiova's low recent corner count is already in. I stay at 10.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.3 cards, already up about 6% for referee Jöllenbeck's 5.3 cards a game and a little for both sides' recent bookings, with Craiova (2.6) expected to collect more chasing the game. Costinha's red at Hull carries a league ban only. I stay at 4.3.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.8 shots, almost 22 of them Brighton's, and already add 2% for Brighton's recent volume. A rotated side without Yalcouyé should create a little less, so I take off 3%, to about 27.9 shots.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.5 shots on target and already take 8% off Brighton for poor recent accuracy, with the injured forwards counted. Rotation points slightly the same way, so I take off 2%, to about 10.3; Craiova's attack, with Al-Hamlawi fit, is unchanged.
